segments.text: Ever fixed the same error twice? Again remembers what you've tried, so you can pick up where you left off.
Here, the administrator check already passed. The problem is starting the worker. Again brings back the earlier failed attempts.
It keeps the outcome honest: worker startup was fixed, but the later trace was still unresolved.
Same error, different situation. If the administrator check failed, the next step changes. Context matters.
